
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; color: rgba(92, 97, 102, 1); background-color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; padding: 1.5em 1em"><blockquote style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; font-size: 0.95em; overflow: auto; border-left: 3px solid rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 12px 20px; margin: 1em 0; background: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1)">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">导读：传统 Word 转文本大多依赖后端服务、Office COM 组件或者在线转换接口，存在部署成本高、文件外传、并发受限等问题。借助 WebAssembly 版本的文档处理库，我们可以完全在前端浏览器内完成 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">.docx</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 到 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">.txt</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 的转换，不需要后端中转，保障文档数据不出本地。本文基于 React + Spire.Doc for JavaScript，给出一套可运行的转换方案并拆解实现细节。</span></p>
</blockquote>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">方案概述</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">本方案核心能力：</span></p>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: disc">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">✅ </span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">纯前端运行</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：所有文档解析、格式转换逻辑跑在浏览器 WASM 环境</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">✅ </span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">无需上传文件到服务器</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：文档全程在用户本地内存与虚拟文件系统（VFS）处理</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">✅ </span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">输出标准 TXT</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：提取 Word 正文内容，去除富文本样式、图片、版式信息，生成纯文本</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">✅ </span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">资源自动释放</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：主动释放文档对象，避免 WASM 内存持续泄漏</span></li>
</ul>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">依赖说明：示例基于 Spire.Doc WebAssembly 模块，提前在页面初始化完成 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">wasmModule</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">、</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">spire</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">、</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">dotnetRuntime</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 挂载，适合 React SPA 项目。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">完整示例代码</span></h2>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">function App() {
  const WordToTxt = async () =&gt; {
    const docModule = window.wasmModule?.spiredoc;
    if (!docModule) {
      alert('Spire.Doc is not ready yet');
      return;
    }
<p>// Load the sample file into VFS<br>
let inputFileName = "WordToTxt.docx";<br>
await window.spire.FetchFileToVFS(inputFileName, "", <code>${process.env.PUBLIC_URL}/static/data/</code>);</p>
<p>// Create a document instance<br>
const doc = new docModule.Document();</p>
<p>// Load the document from the virtual file system<br>
doc.LoadFromFile(inputFileName);</p>
<p>// Define the output file name<br>
const outputFileName = "WordToTxt-result.txt";</p>
<p>// Save the document as plain text<br>
doc.SaveToFile({fileName: outputFileName, fileFormat: docModule.FileFormat.Txt});</p>
<p>// Release resources<br>
doc.Dispose();</p>
<p>const modifiedFileArray = window.dotnetRuntime.Module.FS.readFile(outputFileName);<br>
const blob = new Blob([modifiedFileArray], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });<br>
const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);<br>
const a = document.createElement('a');<br>
a.href = url;<br>
a.download = outputFileName;<br>
a.click();<br>
URL.revokeObjectURL(url);<br>
};</p>
</code><p><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">return (<br>
&lt;div style={{ textAlign: 'center', height: '300px' }}&gt;<br>
&lt;h1&gt;Convert Word To TXT&lt;/h1&gt;<br>
&lt;button onClick={WordToTxt}&gt;Generate&lt;/button&gt;<br>
&lt;/div&gt;<br>
);<br>
}<br>
export default App;<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">代码逐段解析</span></h2>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1. 前置模块校验</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">const docModule = window.wasmModule?.spiredoc;
if (!docModule) {
  alert('Spire.Doc is not ready yet');
  return;
}
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">WASM 模块加载是异步过程，页面渲染完成时不一定就绪。这里做保护判断，如果文档模块还未初始化，直接弹窗提示，避免后续调用报错。在实际项目中，推荐增加加载状态、进度条，而不是简单 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">alert</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">。</span></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2. 将本地资源文件加载到 WASM 虚拟文件系统（VFS）</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">let inputFileName = "WordToTxt.docx";
await window.spire.FetchFileToVFS(inputFileName, "", `${process.env.PUBLIC_URL}/static/data/`);
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">WASM 运行环境拥有独立的虚拟文件系统，不能直接读取浏览器 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">public</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 目录资源。</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">FetchFileToVFS</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 的作用是通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">fetch</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 把静态目录下的 docx 文件拉取，写入 VFS，供 WASM 侧接口读取。</span></p>
<blockquote style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; font-size: 0.95em; overflow: auto; border-left: 3px solid rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 12px 20px; margin: 1em 0; background: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1)">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">拓展：如果需要支持用户上传任意 Word 文件，可改用 FileReader，将用户选择的 File 对象写入 VFS，而不是固定拉取静态示例文件。</span></p>
</blockquote>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">3. 加载文档并执行格式转换</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">const doc = new docModule.Document();
doc.LoadFromFile(inputFileName);
</code><p><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">const outputFileName = "WordToTxt-result.txt";<br>
doc.SaveToFile({fileName: outputFileName, fileFormat: docModule.FileFormat.Txt});<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: disc">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">new Document()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：实例化文档对象</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">LoadFromFile</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：从虚拟文件系统加载 docx</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">SaveToFile</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：核心转换接口，指定输出格式为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Txt</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，引擎自动解析段落、文本，丢弃字体、颜色、表格样式、嵌入对象等富文本信息，只保留文本内容。</span></li>
</ul>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">4. 释放文档资源（非常关键）</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">doc.Dispose();
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">WASM 的内存不受 JS GC 完全管控，文档对象占用的原生内存不会随 JS 对象回收自动释放。必须显式调用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Dispose</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，长期循环转换场景下，如果遗漏这一步，会造成内存持续上涨，最终页面卡顿、崩溃。</span></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">5. 读取 VFS 输出文件，触发浏览器下载</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">const modifiedFileArray = window.dotnetRuntime.Module.FS.readFile(outputFileName);
const blob = new Blob([modifiedFileArray], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
const a = document.createElement('a');
a.href = url;
a.download = outputFileName;
a.click();
URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">转换后的 TXT 文件保存在 WASM 的 FS 里，JS 需要调用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">FS.readFile</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 获取字节数组，再包装为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Blob</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，通过动态创建 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">&lt;a&gt;</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 标签实现浏览器下载。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">进阶改造：支持用户上传任意 Word 文件</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">上面示例是读取固定静态文件，在业务里更常见的是让用户上传。简单改造思路：</span></p>
<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: decimal">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在页面增加 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">&lt;input type="file" accept=".docx"/&gt;</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">FileReader.readAsArrayBuffer</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 读取用户选中文件</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">将二进制数组写入 VFS</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">复用后续加载、转换、导出逻辑</span></li>
</ol>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">这样就不再局限于预放置在 public 目录的示例文档。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">小结</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">借助 WebAssembly，JavaScript 已经可以在浏览器内独立完成 Word 到 TXT 的转换。这套方案把文档解析能力下沉到前端，消除文件上传链路，适合对数据私密性有要求的文档文本提取场景。核心流程可以概括为：</span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">加载 WASM → 文件写入虚拟文件系统 → 文档载入 → 另存为文本格式 → 释放资源 → 读取字节流并下载</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">。</span></p></section>

</div>
